blocks.text: Singer-content creator Chloe San Jose and two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo have revealed that they have been engaged since December 2025. The couple shared the news in a vlog posted on Monday, Sept. 28, where they opened up about keeping the engagement private for nearly nine months. In the vlog, Yulo said he had already been thinking about proposing to San Jose in September 2025, before leaving for Japan for a training camp.
